quizSafeguards.basis: Entry 1421970 sense 1 slow overlaps 1582430 sense 4 slow/sluggish. The late and too-late senses do not automatically transfer to 鈍い.
Entry 1010040 records slowly/sluggishly. The contextual slowness overlap does not transfer its adverb/suru grammar to the i-adjective.
Entry 1013050 sense 1 records slowly/unhurriedly. Deliberate leisure is not necessarily impaired responsiveness; the broad slow label motivates the pair.

Entry 1335750 sense 3 records slow/sluggish/ponderous, distinct from its low-level weight sense. A secondary applicable sense motivates the conservative guard, not a claim that 鈍い means heavy in mass.

Entry 1154330 sense 3 explicitly records dull colour, alongside sense 1 dark/murky. These can meet 1582430 sense 3 dull sound/colour/dim light. The separate existing くらい particle article is not this adjective.

Entry 1601260 sense 2 records stupid/foolish/dull and is usually kana; the written form is ateji. Compare 1582430 sense 2 obtuse/stupid, without transferring noun/na-adjective grammar or every insulting use.

Entry 1011920 sense 1 dimly/faintly and sense 5 fool/dunce can meet dim-light or obtuse readings. Conservative contextual label guard, not unrestricted interchangeability with every absent-minded or idle situation.
Entry 1011760 sense 2 dimly/hazily/faintly can meet the dim-light application of 1582430 sense 3. Its dazed and roaring-flame senses remain separate; the guard is conservative.
Entry 1004040 sense 1 slowly/tardily/dawdling can meet the broad slow/sluggish answer. Complaining, unsettled weather and loose material are not automatically 鈍い senses.
Entry 1007510 senses 3-4 sluggishly/slowly motivate a contextual guard. Dripping and gentle slopes do not establish the same meaning.

Conservative bare-English-dull guard: entry 1008190 sense 1 means dull/uninteresting/boring. The new page explicitly distinguishes boring from 鈍い's blunt or unresponsive uses; Japanese synonymy is not claimed.
Conservative bare-English-dull guard: entry 1596750 sense 1 means tedious/boring/dull. Not a claim that 鈍い is a general translation for an uninteresting film.

Conservative pain-context English-label guard: entry 2121270 sense 2 prolonged dull pain, alongside the separately retained 鈍痛 record 1457660. This is not an adjective-collocation attestation, not its sobbing sense, and not the separate archaic incessantly family 2426010.

quizCurationLimits: A bounded full-JMdict sweep of existing written identities with current article readings, the actual articles/answer labels and the confusable-word inventory inform candidates, not automatic synonym findings. Direct guards are symmetric but not transitive. Several guards are conservative contextual or bare-English-label decisions, not Japanese interchangeability or measured runtime failures. The ore/mineral/crystal sweep established no matching existing lexical identity. General stone or copper is not automatically ore. Thin/pale/faint in 薄い does not by itself establish dull colour; no guard was retained. Gradual 徐々に, incremental じりじり, qualified blunt speaking ずけずけ and cold-weather 寒い were not promoted merely from substring or secondary-gloss matches. The kana くらい article teaches approximate degree, not the homophonous dark adjective. Both complete しくしく families remain recorded, but only entry 2121270 sense 2 motivates the pain-context guard; the separate archaic incessantly family is not merged.
